summary: SABESP, the São Paulo basic sanitation company, furnished a Form 6-K containing its quarterly financial information for the three- and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026, equivalent to a routine interim earnings report for a foreign private issuer. The excerpt shows statements of financial position only: total assets of R$114.1 billion versus R$104.2 billion at December 31, 2025, with non-current borrowings rising to R$44.1 billion and intangible concession assets near R$50.5 billion. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed; no special-situation angle applies.
